system.description:
Islands and coasts, where the sea sets the horizon.

Talent: one Might die to d12, one Finesse die to d8.

  • Salt-Toughened. The first time each conflict an Attribute of yours would take Stress, reduce that Stress by 1, ignoring Resistance.
  • Undertow. You learn the Undertow Technique: Grappling, Stress, Prone, -1 Oppose.
